finding: SaveChangesAsync owns authorization, duplicate detection, display-order allocation, persistence, transaction, telemetry and error mapping.
recommendation: Extract internal collaborators incrementally while keeping the public facade and tests unchanged.

finding: DisplayOrder is allocated as MAX + step without a unique constraint or concurrency-safe allocator.
recommendation: Add a concurrent integration test, then use unique index + retry, sequence/table allocator, or locking.

finding: Duplicate conflict evaluation scans possibleConflicts for every incoming row (O(n*m)).
recommendation: Build a dictionary keyed by normalized identity for O(1) lookup.

finding: Seeder runs on every startup and can race across instances or fail startup on invariant violations.
recommendation: Move bootstrap to deployment or protect with transaction/application lock and idempotent operations.

finding: Status is required in EF but not required by save validation.
recommendation: Decide required vs optional and align DB, server validation, client validation and tests.

finding: Fixed account uniqueness is application-only; concurrent requests can create duplicates, and role rollback delete result is ignored.
recommendation: Add database-enforceable assignment uniqueness or locking/serializable transaction; handle rollback failure.

finding: Admin UI performs EF queries/writes directly and broad catches omit logging.
recommendation: Extract BranchManagementService/query services, add logging and cancellation.

finding: Password change and MustChangePassword reset are separate operations, allowing partial success.
recommendation: Design atomic/recoverable flow and add integration coverage.

finding: Component does not cancel load/save/interop work when disposed despite service cancellation support.
recommendation: Add component CancellationTokenSource and pass tokens.

finding: Inline onclick strings call a global JS object directly.
recommendation: Use Blazor @onclick wrappers or JS module references.

finding: Row mapping/normalization is duplicated across load and save result paths.
recommendation: Extract a mapper and add contract tests.

finding: DateTime.Now.Year is hardcoded in query, service and component.
recommendation: Inject TimeProvider.

finding: initialize and applySavedDelta are 505 and 812 lines.
recommendation: Extract initializer and saved-delta reconciler without changing public API.

finding: One 731-line function owns editing, keyboard, selection and clipboard.
recommendation: Split bindings by concern while lifecycle retains exact handler references.

finding: Several 300-516 line editor/popup/structure functions combine logic and UI.
recommendation: Split incrementally and add fast JS unit tests.

finding: Measured run forces Observe with 650ms SlowMo and always-on trace.
recommendation: Create standalone Performance suite with no SlowMo/trace for quantitative runs.

finding: Performance segment runs late inside the stress mega-journey, so cold is not a clean cold baseline.
recommendation: Use fresh browser/page/grid and independent repeated runs.

finding: Tabulator and all 15 project scripts load on every page, including Login/Admin.
recommendation: Load Work Orders scripts dynamically/on-demand; conditionally load diagnostics.

finding: Whole sheet is held and copied across server, JS, Tabulator and dirty snapshots.
recommendation: Benchmark actual worst-case sheet, 5k and 10k; optimize only with evidence.

finding: Filter option generation scans/maps/sorts full active data.
recommendation: Cache field value indexes and invalidate by row delta if measurements identify it as a hotspot.

finding: CSS consolidation helped, but 125 !important and remaining duplicate selectors indicate residual specificity debt.
recommendation: Define ownership/specificity policy; replace rules rather than append overrides.

finding: Busket typo is pervasive across database and code.
recommendation: Use a dedicated migration/refactor later; do not mix with performance work.

finding: BranchManager and ProjectManager Arabic labels are easy to confuse.
recommendation: Create central role metadata with canonical Arabic/English labels and scope.

finding: A 1,599-line mega journey and 2,854-line page object make isolated diagnosis and change difficult.
recommendation: Split into focused suites/helpers; migrate gradually to standard test framework.

finding: No focused automated tests for account management, seeder, concurrent allocations and status invariant.
recommendation: Add integration tests before expanding those modules.

finding: Current documentation and root patch manifests conflict with actual phase/status.
recommendation: Keep one current status source and archive/remove duplicates.
